contentText:
Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian has been clarifying remarks he made Saturday, saying his apologies to neighboring countries were misinterpreted by enemies. He stated that Iran has been forced to respond to attacks, but this does not mean Tehran doesn’t view neighboring countries as brothers.

For more on these attacks on the Gulf states, journalist Hoda Abdel-Hamid reports the latest from Doha, Qatar.
